_note: Who takes this patient, what they need to see before they will, and what they say. Every sentence here is a clinical claim drafted from the case's own critical actions and its own authored consult responder — nothing is generated, and nothing here has been reviewed. `needs[].action` indexes that case's criticalActions. `needsState[]` are engine flags (rosc, converted) with the consultant's own words for each. `admits` is inherited from the case's own consult responder's `satisfies`; where the case authored none, the gate credits nothing.

needsState.wants: a pulse — call me back when you have ROSC

needs.wants: his airway secured and capnography on it
post-arrest care started — I am not taking him upstairs before he is being cooled

resus-acls-vf.wantsDiagnosis: and tell me what you are calling this
resus-acls-vf.refusePrefix: Cardiology. Before I take him I want
resus-acls-vf.accepts: Cardiology — agreed, that is an occlusion until proven otherwise. The lab is activated and we are taking him now. Good call.
resus-acls-vf.note: Accepting credits action 6, which its own cath-lab responder already credits. Action 6 also asks for a 12-lead, so accepting credits that half too — Kim to split the action or drop `admits` if that is too generous. The cooling requirement is deliberate: 'activate the cath lab' once ended this case on the turn the consultant asked for cooling, and the debrief then marked TTM missed.

needsState.wants: him out of the arrhythmia — synchronised cardioversion before I take him

needs.wants: the shock delivered in sync, after sedation if there is time

resus-acls-unstable-tachy.wantsDiagnosis: and I need to know what you think this rhythm is
resus-acls-unstable-tachy.refusePrefix: Cardiology. I will take him, but first I want
resus-acls-unstable-tachy.accepts: Cardiology — agreed, atrial fibrillation with shock, cardioverted. Send him to the monitored unit and we will see him there. Tell me what you decided about anticoagulation when you write him up.
resus-acls-unstable-tachy.note: Credits nothing: this case's cardiology responder authors no `satisfies`, and its action 6 asks for the anticoagulation decision as well as the admission — accepting must not hand over a decision the player never made. Kim: add `satisfies` to the responder, or split action 6, if the admission should score here.

needs.wants: that thigh packed and pressure held
the chest decompressed — I am not moving her with a tension
blood running, not crystalloid, and the tranexamic acid in

resus-atls-blunt-multi.wantsDiagnosis: and give me your one-line summary of what she has
resus-atls-blunt-multi.refusePrefix: Trauma lead. She is not going anywhere until I have
resus-atls-blunt-multi.accepts: Trauma lead — chest decompressed, pelvis bound, blood running. That is a working resuscitation. We are taking her; neurosurgery and orthopaedics are coming with us.
resus-atls-blunt-multi.note: Accepting credits action 7, which each of this case's four surgical responders already credits. Action 7 also asks that she move to CT or theatre only once chest and pelvis are treated — which is exactly what the four needs above require, so the credit is earned rather than assumed.

needsState.wants: her back in sinus — I am not taking her in SVT

needs.wants: a twelve-lead — I need to see what she was in, not just what she is in now

resus-pals-svt-infant.wantsDiagnosis: and tell me what you are calling the rhythm
resus-pals-svt-infant.refusePrefix: Paediatric cardiology. Before we take her I want
resus-pals-svt-infant.accepts: Paediatric cardiology — agreed, that is SVT and she is back in sinus. We will take her for an echo and a plan for the next episode. Send the strips up with her.
resus-pals-svt-infant.note: Accepting credits action 7 — 'admit for cardiology review, an echocardiogram and a plan for the next episode' — which is purely a disposition and is what an accepted referral IS. This case's cardiology responder authors no `satisfies` today, so this is the one gate that adds a credit the pack did not carry; Kim to confirm.

resus-nrp-apneic-term.accepts: Neonatology — agreed, perinatal asphyxia with secondary apnoea, responding to ventilation. We are taking him for post-resuscitation care. Keep bagging until we are at the cot side.
